# Colour themes

Longhand's themes other than Paper use the published colours of these open-source projects.
Only the colour values are used (no code). All are MIT licensed.

| Theme | Source | Licence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Catppuccin (Latte, Mocha) | https://github.com/catppuccin/palette | MIT |
| Dracula | https://draculatheme.com/spec | MIT |
| Nord | https://www.nordtheme.com | MIT |
| Solarized | https://ethanschoonover.com/solarized | MIT |
| Gruvbox | https://github.com/morhetz/gruvbox | MIT |
| Rosé Pine (Dawn, Main) | https://rosepinetheme.com | MIT |
| Tokyo Night (Light, Night) | https://github.com/enkia/tokyo-night-vscode-theme | MIT |
| Everforest (medium) | https://github.com/sainnhe/everforest | MIT |
| One (Light, Dark) | https://github.com/atom/one-light-syntax, https://github.com/atom/one-dark-syntax | MIT |
| GitHub (Light, Dark default) | https://primer.style/primitives | MIT |
| Flexoki (light, dark) | https://stephango.com/flexoki | MIT |
| Kanagawa (Lotus, Wave) | https://github.com/rebelot/kanagawa.nvim | MIT |
| Ayu (Light, Mirage) | https://github.com/ayu-theme/ayu-colors, https://github.com/ayu-theme/vscode-ayu | MIT |
| Night Owl (Light Owl, Night Owl) | https://github.com/sdras/night-owl-vscode-theme | MIT |
| Tomorrow (Tomorrow, Night) | https://github.com/chriskempson/tomorrow-theme (vim colour files) | MIT |

Where Longhand needs a shade a palette doesn't name (a hover, a row tint), it mixes two of
the theme's own colours. Grey text that would be too faint to read comfortably is deepened
toward the theme's own text colour.

## Themes named for novels (2026-11-12)

The owner asked for themes from palettes people made for four works. These are not software
projects with a licence: they are colour lists published by their makers. Only the colour
values are used. Looked up 2026-11-12.

| Theme | Palette, maker | Source |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Electric Sheep (dark only) | "Replicant", Kenzie Bottoms: a Blade Runner editor theme | https://github.com/kenziebottoms/vscode-theme-replicant |
| Area X | "annihilation cover II" (and its other version, for the white page), Clark Iroz | https://color.adobe.com/explore?q=annihilation |
| 2001 | "HAL 9000", Steve Cooper | https://color.adobe.com/explore?q=hal%209000 |
| Hail Mary (dark only) | "Project Hail Mary", Esther Jeninga; text colour from "project Hail Mary Desperation", Loredana Conte | https://color.adobe.com/explore?q=project%20hail%20mary |

Limits, said plainly: no palette was found for the novel *Do Androids Dream of Electric
Sheep?* itself, so Electric Sheep uses one made for its film. Hail Mary joins two people's
palettes because the first has no light colour to set text in. Adobe Color's own page for
each palette did not open, so the search pages are given. Passed over because their makers
say or suggest they were machine-made: Takk8IS's Blade Runner 2049 theme, framethrower.ai,
two 2026 Omarchy themes.
